title: Benchmarking locally hosted language models for journal editorial work on a compact desktop workstation: benchmark, data and harness
description:
Benchmark, data and execution harness for the manuscript "Benchmarking locally hosted language models for journal editorial work on a compact desktop workstation", submitted to Biophysics and Physicobiology for the special issue "Research with AI Scientists".

Contents: 8 editorial tasks built from a journal's Instructions for Authors, from 5 manuscripts carrying 58 verified seeded defects, and from published reviews of a preprint; 20 open-weight models from 3.3 to 81 GB measured across 313 conditions on one compact desktop workstation; a deterministic baseline that uses no model; and the code that generates every figure and tabulated number.
